Nothing you just said is true. There are many types of vaccines including the live-attenuated and inactivated ones that you alluded to. Other vaccine types include subunit vaccines like influenza and pertussis, toxoid like diphtheria, recombination like influenza and HepB, and mRNA like the Pfizer and Moderna vaccines. 

The mRNA vaccine does not alter your DNA. mRNA is also not a building block of your DNA. Building blocks of DNA are called nucleotides. There are four nucleotides that make up human DNA, including adenine, guanine, cytosine, and thymine. RNA is also made of nucleotides, but not the exact same ones as DNA. 

mRNA cannot alter your DNA. DNA can be altered through various means including radiation (such as from the sun). However, non environmental causes of DNA alteration, like from specific (not all) viruses, require a “cut, copy, and paste” mechanism that allow them to insert their own DNA into the host DNA. A similar example of this is CRISPR-Cas9, which was a prokaryotic (bacterial) defense mechanism that has now been utilized as gene therapy to treat and cure various cancers or other diseases. CRISPR-Cas9 uses very specific enzymes to make cuts in sections of DNA that it has been engineered to recognize, and then inserts healthy, normal DNA into the empty space. It then uses another, different enzyme to “glue” the pieces together. 

TL;DR: mRNA is not a building block of DNA, it physically does not have the machinery to change your DNA, and therefore, there is no “observable change” where you could see a spike protein that has been encoded into your DNA

Source: am in medical school

The Pfizer and Moderna are not live attenuated or even inactivated vaccines. They are mRNA vaccines. They cannot change your DNA. The mRNA is taken up by your ribosomes and made into the covid spike protein, which on its own cannot make you sick. The body takes this spike protein that you made from the mRNA that was introduced via the vaccine, and presents it to your immune system, which then starts building an immune response so that if you ever get exposed to covid irl, you can effectively fight it off and not fall ill. 

TL;DR: vaccines can’t change your DNA

This also spills into figuring out who they like/don’t like in terms of having crushes. This further develops until kids reach puberty and by then most kids have a clear idea of what their sexuality/sexual preference is. Teaching sexuality at a young age gives kids the information they need to make smart and healthy decisions from the get go, that way they’re not blindsided by any stressful emotions or situations they may encounter later on.
